authority: CEO Round 132: 'Before comparing worlds, freeze one common observable contract. The implementation must distinguish model variable from predicted physical observable.'
problem_statement: Each of the 5 worlds defines 'D' (the damage/failure variable) differently. FEBio uses CDM damage [0,1]. Custom peridynamics uses bond-breakage density. Custom flow uses eroded fraction. CalculiX uses plastic strain. SfePy uses elastic strain. These are NOT the same physical quantity. Comparing 'precursor detected' across worlds with non-equivalent D definitions is epistemically meaningless. This is the core of H6 in the contradiction object.

observable_contract.name: C5_precursor_signal
observable_contract.definition: A precursor signal exists when the rate of change of the normalized failure progression variable decelerates (peaks then declines) before the failure variable reaches its critical threshold.

common_progression_variable.name: Phi(t)
common_progression_variable.definition: Normalized failure progression, mapped to [0, 1] for ALL worlds.

mapping_per_world.WORLD_D_CALCULIX: Phi = equivalent_plastic_strain / yield_strain (must be normalized; capped at 1.0)
mapping_per_world.WORLD_E_SFEPY: Phi = max_strain / failure_strain (must be defined; SfePy has no failure model, so Phi is elastic strain / 0.1)

derivative_definition.name: dPhi/dstrain
derivative_definition.computation: Central finite difference of Phi with respect to strain (or strain-equivalent progression variable for flow world).
derivative_definition.smoothing: NONE. Raw derivative. No smoothing or filtering. Per PEP-SLOT5-001-a2: raw second derivative is the signal.

precursor_onset_definition.name: precursor_onset_strain
precursor_onset_definition.definition: The strain at which dPhi/dstrain reaches its maximum value (peak) BEFORE Phi reaches Phi_critical.
precursor_onset_definition.requirement: The peak must occur at strain < D_critical_strain. If the peak occurs after D_critical, there is no precursor.

fragmentation_onset_definition.name: fragmentation_onset_strain
fragmentation_onset_definition.definition: The strain at which Phi first reaches Phi_critical (0.9).
fragmentation_onset_definition.cross_world_note: For FEBio: D=0.9. For peridynamics: 90% bonds broken. For flow: 90% eroded. For CalculiX: plastic strain at 0.9 yield. For SfePy: strain at 0.9 × failure_strain.

lead_time_definition.name: lead_strain
lead_time_definition.lead_time: lead_strain / strain_rate (strain_rate = 0.01 s^-1, frozen per PEP-SLOT5-001-a2)
lead_time_definition.precursor_absent: lead_strain <= 0 OR no peak found before Phi_critical

anti_gaming_rules.no_post_hoc_observable_change: The observable definition is FROZEN. If a world produces no precursor under this definition, the world produces no precursor. Do not change the definition to manufacture a precursor.
anti_gaming_rules.no_world_specific_thresholds: Phi_critical = 0.9 for ALL worlds. No world-specific adjustment.
anti_gaming_rules.no_smoothing: Raw dPhi/dstrain. Smoothing can manufacture or destroy precursor signals.
anti_gaming_rules.no_observable_substitution: If a world does not produce Phi (e.g., SfePy has no failure model), that world reports Phi = elastic_strain / 0.1. This is a proxy, clearly labeled. It cannot confirm or deny the precursor — it can only report whether the proxy shows the pattern.

model_variable_vs_physical_observable.distinction: The model variable (D_CDM, bond_breakage_density, eroded_fraction, plastic_strain, elastic_strain) is a MODEL-SIDE quantity. The physical observable (force curvature, displacement, pressure) is a MEASUREMENT-SIDE quantity. The precursor hypothesis claims a physical observable exists before fragmentation. The model variable is a PREDICTION of when that physical observable would appear.
model_variable_vs_physical_observable.per_article_I: The physical experiment (PEP-SLOT5-001-a2) tests the PHYSICAL OBSERVABLE (force curvature), not the model variable. The model variable is a prediction. Reality is the judge.
model_variable_vs_physical_observable.implication_for_cross_world: Even if all 5 worlds agree on the model variable, that does NOT confirm the physical precursor exists. It only confirms the models agree. Physical confirmation requires physical experiment.

re_analysis_required.action: Re-run all 5 worlds with this common observable contract. Re-compute precursor detection using the normalized Phi.
re_analysis_required.expected_outcome: The custom World C positive result may disappear when the observable is properly normalized. Or it may survive, strengthening H1. Either way, the comparison becomes epistemically meaningful.
re_analysis_required.status: QUEUED — C5-CONTRA-E03 (highest acquisition score among executable experiments)
